The Democratic Socialists of America are winning elections — and sending waves of joy and terror through the Democratic Party. A little historical context might be useful.

Before you celebrate or panic, there’s a lot to learn here. The Party’s past tells a story that’s getting lost in all the noise. It's both more hopeful, and more cautionary, than either side probably wants to admit.

Black entrepreneurs changed the world with two turntables and a microphone. Hip-hop is now a global economy, a fashion industry and a language spoken by billions. What comes next will be bigger.

Private space exploration. Biotech. Quantum computing. AI. These are young industries, and the ground floor is still open.

If we show up for this moment, the next decade could generate more Black wealth than any period in American history.

What are you building?

posts.text:
I’ve been arrested a few times. But the last time was different.

About a decade ago, I was arrested alongside coal miners from Appalachia. They were fighting back after a big coal company stole their pensions and healthcare.

Many liberals ignored their fight, because the miners were red state voters. They said, “Why should we fight for THEIR rights – when they vote against OURS??”

But I saw it differently. I went to the protest anyway. And I learned something very valuable. Watch this video.
